summary: Persist per-PR spend caps (max wakes, max hours) for babysit --watch (#1081).
migration_impact: No repository migration. Watch loops can use local cap ledgers under .agentic/babysit/ once wired into the CLI; this release only adds the library module.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core to the release that contains this module.
3. After a cap pause, resume with `gh plate pr babysit <n> --watch` once integration lands.
agent_notes: Use plate_core.pr_watch_caps for wake/hour limits before polling GitHub in a watch loop. Post at most one cap PR comment containing <!-- plate-babysit-cap -->; use has_cap_note to dedupe. Do not bypass caps by deleting the ledger unless the human explicitly resets babysit spend.
